sessions.title: Barry Sonnenfeld’s Closet Picks
sessions.description: The director, cinematographer, and author reminisces about working with the Coen brothers and getting married at the wrap party for Miller’s Crossing; shares what he loves about Errol Morris’s directorial techniques; and talks about his favorite movie of all time, Dr. Strangelove, or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb.
